### TUNE: Open - The least filtered option. Built on Balanced rather than Competitive, so mid-level sound comes up harder and less bright content is held back, with a higher ceiling on the footstep band. Slow leveller timing, so it stays smooth.
### SELF GUN: High - A light trim on your own gunfire. Keeps most of its punch.
### OUTPUT: Needs the SonicScout2.0 + (16ch) output.
